newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds end the week quietly.
newsitem.headline: European feeds end the week quietly.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market ended a dull week quietly with only a few trades reported, market sources said.

"Despite the firmer tone in the market after yesterday's lower USDA carry-over figure for soybeans there was little buying interest this afternoon. It seems that many buyers do not have much faith in the market," one broker said.

Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $308 a tonne cif Rotterdam. Spot Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $157 a tonne fob Rotterdam. Feb/April EU rapemeal changed hands at 28.65 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
